_metadata.name: PAMF Hospitalist Discharge Summary (Template B, exact)
_metadata.style: Exact reproduction of the PAMF Hospitalist 'Discharge Summary' Epic shell. Each free-text '***' blank is a single composed text field (restructure.py stitches the underlying standardized fields into it); labeled slots (Patient, Medications, Vitals) stay structured. A catch-all at the end holds anything with no native slot.
_metadata.based_on: PAMF Hospitalist 'Discharge Summary' Epic template (Template contents (1).pdf)
_metadata.content_parity_note: Native (composed + structured) fields consume a set of standardized paths; the catch-all holds the rest. Consumed ∪ catch-all = the full standardized field set, identical to template_A_exact.
_metadata.field_types: A field may be: mapped (one standardized path), 'static' (fixed boilerplate), 'composed' (free-text stitched from several standardized paths), or a 'catch_all' section (all remaining fields).
_metadata.null_convention: Use JSON null for any field absent from the source note.

patient.description: Patient and encounter identification (labeled fields in the shell).

attending_at_discharge.description: Attending physician at time of discharge

discharge_diagnoses.description: Free-text blank: principal and secondary diagnoses.

diagnoses.example: Community-acquired pneumonia; acute hypoxic respiratory failure; COPD exacerbation.

summary_of_hospital_course.description: Free-text '***' blank: one-liner plus brief problem-based course and response.

summary.example: 64yo M with HTN/COPD admitted for pneumonia. Pneumonia: IV then oral antibiotics; hypoxia weaned off O2. Improved, hypoxia resolved.

mandatory_hf_ami_documentation.display_name: Mandatory Documentation for Heart Failure or Acute Myocardial Infarction

quality_measures.static: AMI/HF quality measures documented per the AMI or HF Quality smartset when applicable.
quality_measures.description: PAMF static HF/AMI mandatory documentation attestation.

disposition.description: Free-text blank: discharge destination and support (home vs SNF).

follow_up.example: PCP 2024-05-12 10:00 AM. Follow up with PCP in 1 week.

significant_findings_studies_procedures.description: Free-text '***' blank plus @RADRESULTS@/@PENDINGLABS@: labs, imaging, studies, procedures, consults, pending labs.

findings.example: WBC 8.1, Na 139, Cr 0.9. CXR: RLL consolidation. EKG: NSR. Thoracentesis 5/2 — exudative effusion. Pulmonology consulted. Pending: blood culture.

medications.description: Each entry has name, dose, route, frequency, indication.

additional_discharge_instructions.description: Free-text '@DISCHARGEPROC@' slot: activity, diet, wound care, monitoring, equipment, other.

instructions.example: Activity as tolerated. Regular diet. Return if fever or worsening dyspnea.

condition_and_exam_at_discharge.description: Below-the-line documentation (not copied into PAMF Epic): vitals (@VS@) and exam '***'.

do_not_copy_separator.static: ——————— do not copy info below this line into PAMF Epic ———————

vital_signs.example: BP 124/78, HR 72, RR 16, afebrile, SpO2 96% RA

exam.description: Composed exam on day of discharge.
exam.example: Stable. Ambulating independently. Alert and oriented x3. Pain well controlled.

attestation.static: The CURES database was reviewed before prescribing any opiates for this patient.

attending_sign_off.description: PAMF static sign-off and medical-decision-making statement.

medical_decision_making.static: Medical decision making: >50% of the encounter spent counseling patient and family on lab/imaging results, medication changes/monitoring, and discharge plans. Coordinated with RN and case management regarding discharge plans; PAMF Epic updated and PCP notified.

additional_clinical_information.description: Catch-all: note-derived facts with no native PAMF slot (age/sex/DOB/LOS, HPI, admitting dx, PMH, patient education, code status). Filled by restructure.py so content matches template_A_exact.
